insight: Apache-2.0 and fully self-hostable — a langfuse-style tracing-plus-eval platform you own, with an optional Comet-hosted cloud.
name: Opik
tagline: Open-source LLM evaluation, tracing, and monitoring.
description: Open-source platform from Comet for debugging and evaluating LLM and agent apps: full tracing of calls, tools, and agent steps, LLM-as-a-judge and heuristic evals, prompt management, and production dashboards. Self-host via Docker or Kubernetes, or use Comet's hosted cloud.

modelSupport.notes: Framework-agnostic tracing; LLM-as-a-judge metrics run on a model you configure.
